The QA pair is factually accurate; red sprites are indeed upper-atmospheric phenomena triggered by powerful positive cloud-to-ground lightning strikes in the storm below.

The question's premise is outdated because Bohemian Rhapsody is no longer the only song to be the UK Christmas Number One twice, as Wham's 'Last Christmas' also achieved this feat in December 2024 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_UK_singles_chart_Christmas_number_ones).
Justin Bieber remains the only artist in Billboard 200 history to score five number-one albums before the age of 19, as verified by Billboard and Guinness World Records.
The claimed answer 'c' is incorrect; the first rap single to reach number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1990 was 'Ice Ice Baby' by Vanilla Ice (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ice_Ice_Baby).

Taylor Swift became the first artist in history to win the Grammy Award for Album of the Year four times with her win for 'Midnights' in February 2024, and no other artist has matched or surpassed this since.

Although Rick Derringer sang 'Rock and Roll, Hoochie Koo' and produced Weird Al Yankovic, he never produced records for Steely Dan, whose classic albums were produced by Gary Katz (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gary_Katz).

The premise that only one country has territory in all four hemispheres is false; France also has integral territories spanning all four hemispheres (such as Réunion in the Southern/Eastern hemispheres and French Guiana in the Northern/Western hemispheres), as do the US and UK via their overseas territories (https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/kiribati-only-nation-four-hemispheres/).
Brendan Fraser correctly won the Best Actor Oscar for the 2022 film 'The Whale' (awarded in 2023) and played the title character in the 1997 live-action film 'George of the Jungle'.

The core facts of the question are correct; the Catatumbo lightning occurs over Lake Maracaibo and is famously known as a natural lighthouse due to its high frequency of occurring on up to 260–300 nights a year.

Avengers: Endgame still holds the all-time speed record of reaching $2 billion worldwide in 11 days, remaining undefeated even after Spider-Man: Brand New Day crossed the mark in 17 to 19 days in August 2026.
Jisoo's appearance on Hot Ones on July 30, 2026, successfully completed the individual appearances of all four BLACKPINK members on the show, achieving the group's 'four-for-four' milestone.
The movie 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' was released in July 2026, not 2025 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spider-Man:_Brand_New_Day).

The question's premise is stale; the Oregon fungus was surpassed in 2022 by a clonal seagrass (Posidonia australis) in Western Australia that covers about 200 square kilometres (https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/606952-largest-living-organism).

The question falsely asserts that Gemini 6 made the first live musical performance in space; according to Guinness World Records, the first was a vocal performance by Vostok cosmonauts in August 1962 (https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/105445-first-musical-performance-in-space).
The falling snow was actually made of crushed gypsum, not asbestos, as confirmed by MGM makeup artist Charles Schram in the definitive production history 'The Wizardry of Oz'.
KPop Demon Hunters is a 2025 animated film (released June 20, 2025), not a 2026 film, though it won its Academy Awards at the 2026 ceremony.

The question falsely asserts that both inventors were American; while Alfred Fielding was American, his co-inventor Marc Chavannes was Swiss (https://www.smithsonianmag.com/innovation/accidental-invention-bubble-wrap-180971325/).

The belief that archaeologists found 3,000-year-old edible honey in Egyptian tombs is a popular myth; actual ancient honey degrades into dry, blackened residues, and the liquid found in the tomb of Yuya and Tjuyu was proven to be castor oil (https://aucklandbeekeepersclub.org.nz/articles/the-shelf-life-of-honey-a-sticky-myth-uncovered).
